evidence.mission_note: A manual S52 Z3 M fits the Z3 lane and the keeper framing within budget, but at 72.5k miles with no records and a compromised soft top it is a weak year-round rain car. It stands well only if documentation and a PPI turn up. A clean, well-specified MX-5 RF remains the primary target.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 1998 Z3 M Roadster whose M-specific features are visible in the photos, with a factory manual and a glossy green metallic finish. Everything else rests on seller prose: no VIN, title photo, history report or service records are provided. Observed issues are a power top the seller has switched to manual operation, worn driver seat bolsters and steering-wheel leather, and an aftermarket Kenwood head unit. The claimed new brakes, front calipers and low-mileage tires carry no receipts or date codes. Both model-critical items that apply, rear subframe/trunk-floor condition and cooling-system history, are entirely missing; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply to this S52 car. The $16,500 ask sits inside the fair-value range and slightly under its midpoint. The car has been listed for about a year, including a pending sale that did not complete.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, title photo, tire date codes, brake receipts and trunk-floor/underside photos, and confirm he will allow a mobile PPI on a lift in Virginia Beach before any deposit.
